name: Pixel Canvas Card Grid
description: Grid of dark icon cards that fill with a shimmering pixel canvas radiating from the center on hover or focus, with a tinted border and icon.
contents: Grid of cards, each with an icon and an accessible hidden label button
Canvas layer per card with colored pixels
behavior: Pixels appear outward from the card center on hover or focus and shimmer, then shrink away on leave
Border and icon tint to the card active color on hover
Radial vignette fades and a center glow appears on hover
Canvas resizes with the card via ResizeObserver; reduced motion removes the delay and shimmer
Grid is 2 columns on mobile and tablet, 4 on large screens
editableByProps: Number of cards, labels, icon choice (layout, code, command, dropper)
Per card hover tint, pixel colors, pixel gap (4 to 50), pixel speed (0 to 100) and focus behavior

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card border color, aspect ratio or vignette colors
needsCodeEdit.where: className and style of the pc-card div inside Card

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Cards use a dark styling with fixed vignette and glow colors
